decisions.rationale: Primary success alone does not qualify all four routes. Narrow and broad both pass 32/32 primary cases, but narrow falsely accepts bracket-only quotations in Prose and RhetoricalLens. Broad is selected using all three historical strata plus the paired local adjacent reproduction, for bounded source/shape use only.

Source membership checks whether quoted material occurs under the checker's matching rules. It cannot establish that the source's claim is true, that evidence exists, or that a grade is warranted. No factual-truth assessment was available or performed.

All 58 cases predate this task. Historical-transfer wording variants are not fresh random cases, despite fresh-prefixed IDs. A retrospective ranking does not test revisions actually selected through repeated primary-score optimization against separate outcomes.

For the stipulated finite CSV contract, an independently justified reference parser checking exact row equality with positive, negative, valid-alternative and shortcut controls can establish that bounded result. Population correlation or model calibration is not a prerequisite. No CSV artifact was supplied or executed here; this resolves the stated conditional, not an actual exporter verdict.

Equally authoritative conflicting references with no owner resolution cannot establish confirmed pass or fail. Preserve both interpretations, exclude the case from confirmed denominators and request adjudication. Defer or narrow selection if resolving it differently could change the choice. The hypothetical disputed paraphrase is not silently added to the 58 historical cases.

A measurement-design-only request ends with the design and designed/unqualified status as applicable. Missing qualification does not authorize trials. Describe the next test without running it unless the user authorizes execution.
